title: AI Engr.
description:
**AI Engineer**

*iRONic Ventures | Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time | 2 Openings*

**The Role**

We're looking for two AI Engineers to build AI features into a production SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe. You'll work in TypeScript across the stack, connecting LLMs and generative models to a real application: designing prompts and structured outputs, building evaluations and tests around them, and keeping AI suggestions inside the guard rails of validated business logic. This is a product engineering role, not a research or model-training role. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **AI Features:** Design and build LLM-powered features end to end, from prompt and structured output to API, UI, and tests
* **Generative Media:** Integrate image-generation and image-editing models, and measure output quality, latency, and cost per result
* **Guard Rails:** Treat AI output as a proposal that deterministic, validated code checks before anything reaches the user
* **Evaluation:** Build evaluation sets and automated checks so prompt and model changes are compared on evidence, not guessed
* **Data Integration:** Import, map, and validate structured data from external partners, using AI where it saves manual work
* **Configuration Tooling:** Build tools that let non-technical admins configure business rules safely
* **Production:** Add logging and monitoring around expensive AI calls, and troubleshoot and fix production issues
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with the test discipline that keeps their output trustworthy

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years of professional software engineering, including at least one LLM-based feature shipped to production
* **Programming:** Strong TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable writing SQL
* **LLM Engineering:** OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, schema validation (e.g. Zod), tool calling
* **Evaluation & Testing:** Automated tests and evals for code that depends on non-deterministic model output
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, data modelling, and working with messy external data
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Image-generation APIs, vector search (pgvector), job queues (Redis, BullMQ), Next.js and React, three.js, Python for evaluation scripts, German language

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

* **Builders, not just investors:** We're engineers who invest. Product decisions are made by people who read the code
* **AI-native by default:** Coding agents, automated tests, and fast release cycles are how every team works here, not an experiment
* **More than one codebase:** Work across new ventures, our own products, and client builds instead of maintaining one system for years
* **Be early in Kochi:** Join the first engineers in our Kochi office, help shape how it works, and work hand in hand with the team in Berlin
* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

**To Apply**

Upload your resume, your LinkedIn profile, and a short note (3-4 sentences) on why you'd be a great fit for the role. Include one thing you built with AI coding tools and how you checked that it worked.

Pay: From ₹380,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* SaaS: 2 years (Required)
* Node.js: 2 years (Required)

Location:

* Kochi, Kerala (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Associate - DataEngineer - EDS
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 12, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1749246

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Position Description Summary**

**Position Details:**

**Job Title:** Senior Associate Data Analyst– Power Platform - EDS

  

**Job purpose**

As a Senior Associate, you will collaborate with business reporting and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, perform data analysis, and support project transitions. You will lead transition activities where required and manage post-transition development, enhancements, and modifications. You will work across multiple projects with back-end data architects and systems engineers to build data objects that support business needs. You will also apply specialized knowledge to advance the organization’s vision and direction while serving as the team’s subject matter expert.

  

**Specific Role requirements**

* Ability to analyze large sets of data and determine patterns and rules for organizing and Prepare Visualization dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to work on database management and data modelling.
* Working knowledge in developing low code solutions using power platform tools like Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Sound knowledge in ETL concepts and tools like Data Factory/SSIS.
* Design and support database and table structures for new and evolving sources of data
* Experience in working with version control tools like Git/Github
* Perform extensive and detailed data analysis necessary to ensure strict adherence to data quality.
* Take on end-to-end ownership and perform different roles within analysis and development phases.
* Set and manage expectations with clients while providing proactive communication and status updates; prioritize deliverables with client/requestor and follow/implement change control and release management processes.
* Ability to handle multiple projects and coordinate between teams from different service lines.
* Good problem solving skills and business acumen.
* Adhere to general work requirements and perform other duties as assigned.
* Clear understanding of Gen AI tools and their integrations.

  

**Client Responsibilities:**

* Need to be curious and ask the right questions to frame problems and find right analytic solutions.
* Need to work as a senior team member to contribute to various technical streams of Decision Sciences implementation project.
* Provide product and design level with the best technical practices.
* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
* Develop analytical strategies for business by leveraging the right analytical techniques and technologies.
* Documenting and presenting work to the client. Proactively recommending and influencing changes in business decision-making.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the lead

  

**Experience and Qualification:**

* More than 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst with strong expertise in SQL/T-SQL, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
* Knowledge of ETL tools such as SSIS and Azure Data Factory will be an added advantage.
* Experience with Python coding and Databricks will be beneficial.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel macros will be an added advantage.
* Experience working in an Agile environment.
* Prior client-facing experience is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related field.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Nutcracklab is an AI analytics company building intelligent products that help businesses make better decisions using data, predictive analytics and artificial intelligence.We are building a portfolio of AI\-driven products across multiple business domains and are looking for a **Founding Product Engineer** to help take these products from MVP and prototype stages into reliable, production\-ready systems.

Must Have

· **4\+ years of professional software engineering experience**

· Strong **Python** development skills

· Strong **SQL** skills

· Experience with **PostgreSQL** or equivalent relational databases

· Experience building **REST APIs**

· Experience with **FastAPI, Flask, Django or equivalent**

· Strong experience with **Pandas / NumPy**

· Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics or AI applications

· Experience with **Git/GitHub**

· Experience with **Docker**

· Experience deploying applications to a cloud environment

· Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills

· Understanding of software architecture and production engineering practices

Preferred

· Experience with **Microsoft Azure**

· Azure ML or equivalent ML deployment experience

· Experience with **Streamlit**

· Data engineering / ETL

· API and third\-party system integrations

· CI/CD and GitHub Actions

· Application monitoring and logging

· Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture

· Experience taking products from **prototype/MVP → production**

· Experience working in **retail, e\-commerce or other data\-intensive business domains**

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Can independently investigate and solve technical problems.

· Is comfortable working with incomplete or evolving requirements.

· Can make practical architecture and technology decisions.

· Can balance speed of delivery with engineering quality.

· Enjoys working across multiple technical areas rather than being restricted to one narrow function.

· Has strong product thinking in addition to coding ability.

· Is comfortable working directly with founders and customers.

· Is excited by the opportunity to build new products from the ground up.

**Why Join NutCrackLab?**

* This is an early\-stage opportunity with significant technical ownership.You will have the opportunity to:

· Build AI products from the ground up.

· Work directly with the founder.

· Influence architecture and technology decisions.

· Work across AI, data and product engineering.

· Take products from **idea → prototype → MVP → production**.

· Help establish the company’s engineering culture and technical foundation.

· Eventually help build and lead the engineering team as the product portfolio grows.
